verdict.rationale: All documented GoDaddy endpoints (search, register, DNS, renewals, lock, forwarding) operate on a single domain at a time, and rate-limit headers imply per-call throttling rather than a batch/bulk API. No evidence pack item shows a bulk-operation endpoint (e.g., batch DNS updates, multi-domain registration in one call), only 'no limit on number of domains' pricing which is unrelated to bulk execution.
